name: Band Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Pin a resistance band under the ball of one foot, hold its ends at shoulder height, and lift your free foot.
Keep your standing knee straight with a tiny unlock and brace your core.
Press firmly through the ball of your standing foot to raise your heel as high as possible against the band.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor, then switch sides after completing one leg.
tips: Push evenly through the ball of your foot without rolling onto your outer ankle.
Pause briefly at the top rather than bouncing rapidly off the floor.
